title: Check Your Pantry: Ground Cinnamon Recalled Over Lead, Including Brands Sold at Dollar Stores
excerpt: Just as holiday baking season begins, a recall of ground cinnamon products over elevated lead levels is reaching shoppers — including brands sold at Family Doll
content:
Just as holiday baking season begins, a recall of ground cinnamon products over elevated lead levels is reaching shoppers — including brands sold at Family Dollar and Dollar Tree, stores familiar to Laredo households.

Mesa County Public Health, relaying the FDA-linked recall, lists the recalled products as: La Fiesta Ground Cinnamon sold by La Superior SuperMercados; Marcum Ground Cinnamon sold by Save A Lot; MK Cinnamon Powder sold by SF Supermarket; Swad Cinnamon Powder sold by Patel Brothers; Supreme Tradition Ground Cinnamon sold by Family Dollar and Dollar Tree; and El Chilar Ground Cinnamon sold by La Joya Morelense.

The recall is due to elevated levels of lead. Based on the FDA's assessment, prolonged exposure to these products may be unsafe and could contribute to elevated levels of lead in the blood, according to the county health notice.

Reports differ on the recall's exact scope — some outlets cite 14 states, others 13 — and no single published list names every affected state; Ohio, Indiana and North Carolina have been specifically mentioned in coverage. Webb Watch is flagging that discrepancy rather than stating a state count as settled fact, and readers should check the FDA's full product list rather than relying on a state count.

Shoppers who find one of the listed brands in their pantry should discard the recalled cinnamon, as public health notices advise, and check product labels against the FDA list. The recall notices do not report confirmed illnesses tied to these cinnamon products in the materials reviewed for this story.

This is a label-check story, not a panic story: cinnamon is a pantry staple in border households, and the practical step is simple — verify the brand before the next batch of holiday baking.

Sources:
